entities.name: PMID:25100892
observations: Pilot human study of eight adults with type 2 diabetes: caffeine 1.5 mg/kg before 40 minutes of exercise at 40% heart-rate reserve plus 10-minute recovery; glucose sampled every 10 minutes.

entities.name: Caffeine lowers exercise glucose
observations: The pilot abstract reports caffeine reduced blood glucose by 75 mg/dL (65%) versus other treatment groups during the exercise protocol (p<0.05); this shows lower measured glucose, not improved glucose availability.
Only one direct small study was identified; abstract-level reporting lacks timepoint values and comparator-specific magnitude.
